title: Ines and the Wolf
author: Xanthe Blackwood
blurb: Orsen Villalobos, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
